title: Crater lake with deep, ancient, large sharks
content: The setting of the lake may vary slightly, but it's typically in a deep crater surrounded by mountains. If you can get to a high enough vantage point, you can see massive pale sharks that look scarred up. They seem like they must be thousands of years old. The feeling of seeing the lake and the sharks is deep dread. They know you're up there and they can recognize you. Usually there is some sort of wooden walkway or pier suspended high above the lake which seems very rickety and dangerous.
